comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: what are the quickest ways to rank this?

comments.author: JR
comments.body:
I don't have any grind route walkthroughs for it but maybe some of this will help..

Salvaging shipwrecks will get you up to around r8 in decent time if you're doing it all day, assuming you're lower level unlock.

Archive maps are probably the best way to go, get a couple of unlock boosters, easy to get +2 to your base skill now days and get as many maps you can fit in your inventory and go bust them off. The higher the map above your skill the better, of course. And remember you can do maps that are 2 above your skill level, so if you're r6+2 you can do r10 unlock maps, just takes a few more tries to unlock them. Make sure you're turning in the map discoveries so you can get the same maps again. Check ivyros listing of archive maps to figure out what archives are best to search for maps that suit your level and what maps are best to search company shops for.

And of course have a job that favours unlock to cut in half how many skill points you need. Thief job will also add +1 to it as do some aides if you're really wanting to rank it fast.

So overall, combine salvaging with unlock quests and archive maps and try to always be unlocking above your base level with a job favouring the unlock skill.

comments.author: Theo
comments.body:
The best and fastest way to level up this skill including search skill is the map from Venice -> archives

Religious painting map
Church at Naples
By the wall on the right of seats at the back.
Search, Art, Unlock Rank8

- You need Art r8 and you can use +boost items. Ex Art r6 + 2
- Use the college skills "Research knowledge 1 and 2" for xtra prof.
- You need an alt (who doesnt have this days :-)) to pass the map
otherwise it wont show up if its in your inventory/vault/quarters. One alt can carry a max of 50+16 = 66 maps.
- You need about 35 headache meds to fillup one alt

I did this during the last event x1.2 which became x2 and later x3. From r4 unlock and search I reached r16 search and r15 unlock and max r16 Art. Gained 8 adv levels and reach 100k adv fame within 3-5 days (4hrs playing time a day). Takes 1 min to search in naples church and submit discovery to the mansion just below the church map then just repeat the process.
